name: bruh
description: Coordinate Claude Code sessions across projects and machines: bigm, clankers, clerks, and workflows.

user_name.title: bruh: Your name
user_name.description: How bruh addresses you. The install dialog asks it; /config changes it.

handoff_percent.title: bruh: Handoff threshold (percent)
handoff_percent.description: At this context use, a role session updates its handoff.

max_busy_clerks.title: bruh: Busy clerk cap
max_busy_clerks.description: The maximum number of clerks that work at the same time.

orca_local.title: bruh: Show local sessions in Orca
orca_local.description: auto: when the Orca app runs, each local role session gets an Orca tab that runs claude attach. off: bruh runs no orca command for local sessions.

board_design.title: bruh: Board design
board_design.description: The look of the /bruh-board pane. cards: bordered cards. buckets: sections by state. pipeline: a strip across the deliver phases for each task. A change shows in the open pane at once.

slack_bot_token.title: bruh: Slack bot token
slack_bot_token.description: Bot token (xoxb-...) of the internal Slack app of bruh. Leave empty when you do not use Slack.

slack_channel_id.title: bruh: Slack channel ID
slack_channel_id.description: ID of the Slack channel where bigm posts P0 and P1 questions, for example C0123456789.

slack_owner_user_id.title: bruh: Your Slack user ID
slack_owner_user_id.description: Only messages of this Slack user reach bigm, for example U0123456789.
